title: Phase 3 near-miss: archive_signal omitted status mutation and schema enum entry; caught by Phase 5 QA
description: In run c6af8022-8df4-4edf-8bb0-97b1a8dda8b8, the initial Phase 3 implementation of archive_signal.rs set archived_on and resolution_summary but did not set status='archived' as required by spec Step 3 point 4. Additionally, signal.schema.json was not updated to include 'archived' in the status enum despite the spec's Mermaid diagram showing 'archived' as a valid status node. Both omissions were caught during Phase 5 QA Architect inline review and patched before commit, so no broken artifact was committed. Root cause: the spec's schema extension step (Step 1b) did not enumerate the new enum value alongside the new fields, and the implementation checklist did not cross-verify all field mutations against the spec step.
proposed_resolution: Add a Phase 3 implementation checklist item: 'For every new tool execute(), verify each field mutation listed in the spec's implementation logic is present in the Rust code.' Additionally, when a spec step introduces a new status value (e.g., 'archived'), the schema extension step should explicitly list the enum addition alongside the new field additions.
